title: appwrite/appwrite
lede: Appwrite is a BSD-licensed backend platform bundling auth, databases, storage, functions, messaging, realtime and hosting, with an MCP server so coding agents can operate on a live project.

points: Auth covers email, SMS, OAuth, anonymous sessions and magic URLs; databases include managed PostgreSQL and MySQL options.
Sites deploys static, SSR and CSR frontends from Git with previews, and a Firewall product adds traffic rules and abuse controls.
The hosted MCP server signs in with OAuth, so Cursor, Claude Code or Codex connect without API keys; self-hosters use a local server.
Self-hosting is one Docker command that starts a setup wizard bound to localhost and guarded by a one-time installer secret.
Client SDKs span web, Flutter, Apple, Android, React Native and Unity, and server SDKs cover ten languages.
